# Meridian Analytics — Employee Onboarding Guide

Welcome to Meridian Analytics! This guide covers everything you need for a smooth first
week. If anything is unclear, reach out to your manager or HR.

---

## Day 1 Setup

### Accounts & Access
- [ ] Receive your Meridian email (`<firstname>.<lastname>@meridiananalytics.io`) from IT
- [ ] Set up Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)
- [ ] Activate your Slack account and join `#general`, `#engineering`, `#announcements`
- [ ] Log in to the Meridian Analytics platform at `app.meridiananalytics.io`
- [ ] Set up 1Password (password manager) — your vault invite arrives by email
- [ ] Enable MFA on all company accounts before Day 2

### Physical / Badge
- [ ] Collect your office keycard from Kenji Obi (HR Manager) — desk 4B, second floor
- [ ] Sign the equipment acceptance form for your assigned laptop
- [ ] Take a building safety briefing with the office manager

### Tools to Install
| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| Slack | Team communication |
| Zoom | Video calls |
| GitHub | Source code (Engineering) |
| Figma | Design collaboration (Product/Engineering) |
| Notion | Internal documentation |

---

## Week 1 Tasks

- [ ] 1:1 with your direct manager (Day 1, 30 min)
- [ ] Team introduction call — attend `#standup` at 9:30 am daily
- [ ] Read the Company Handbook in Notion (link shared on Day 1)
- [ ] Complete Security Awareness training (mandatory, ~45 min)
- [ ] Complete GDPR & Data Handling training (mandatory, ~30 min)
- [ ] Shadow a colleague in your team for half a day
- [ ] Submit your signed offer letter copy and ID documents to Kenji Obi
- [ ] Set up your direct deposit and benefits enrolment in Rippling (deadline: Day 5)

---

## Key Contacts

| Name | Role | Department | Email |
|------|------|------------|-------|
| Kenji Obi | HR Manager | HR | k.obi@meridiananalytics.io |
| Priya Nair | CTO | Engineering | p.nair@meridiananalytics.io |
| Rachel Kim | VP of Sales | Sales | r.kim@meridiananalytics.io |
| Hannah Park | Head of Product | Product | h.park@meridiananalytics.io |
| Claire Fontaine | CFO | Finance | c.fontaine@meridiananalytics.io |

For IT issues: open a ticket in the `#it-help` Slack channel.

---

## Policies Summary

- **Working hours:** Core hours are 10 am – 4 pm local time. Flexible outside these times.
- **Expenses:** Submit expenses within 30 days of purchase via Ramp. Meals > $75 require
  prior approval. Hardware purchases > $300 require manager sign-off.
- **PTO:** 20 days per year (accrued monthly). Submit requests in Rippling ≥ 5 business
  days in advance for planned leave.
- **Remote work:** Fully remote-friendly. Office available Tuesday–Thursday.
- **Confidentiality:** All employees sign an NDA on Day 1. Do not share customer data,
  deal information, or financial figures outside the company.
- **Code of Conduct:** Reviewed during Week 1 training. Zero tolerance for harassment.

For the full policy list see the Company Handbook in Notion.

-------------------
Rachel Kim opened with a summary of Q3 performance.

- Total revenue closed (won deals): $1,040,000 across 14 closed-won deals.
- 22 total deals worked in the quarter; win rate 63.6%.
- South region led all territories at $468,000 in closed revenue.
- Largest single deal: D019 — Sofia Delgado — $198,000 — Meridian Insights Pro
  (signed September 5, Southern enterprise account).
- Pipeline carry-over into Q4: D007 ($7,800), D013 ($105,000), D020 ($115,000),
  D022 ($11,000) — total pending ~$239,300.

James Okafor noted that the North region pipeline is especially strong heading into Q4,
with two new prospects from the BostonTech conference (see EX001 travel expense).

2. ENGINEERING & PRODUCT UPDATE

4. HR UPDATE
-------------
Kenji Obi confirmed headcount is stable at 15. Two engineering hire requisitions will be

New joiner orientation materials (see onboarding_guide.md) have been refreshed for the

Subject: Re: High Priority: Onboarding Equipment Setup Needed - Follow-Up
Content-Type: text/plain; charset="utf-8"

MIME-Version: 1.0

Hi Priya,

I wanted to follow up on our earlier thread regarding the onboarding equipment setup for the incoming engineering hires we discussed during the Q3 review on September 8.

As you know, the two engineering hire requisitions are slated for submission to the board by October 1, and I want to make sure IT and equipment provisioning stay ahead of the timeline. Here's where we stand and what I'd like to align on:

1. Laptop & Hardware Allocation
   We need to confirm the standard engineering hardware spec (laptop model, peripherals, monitors) so we can place orders with enough lead time. Per our expense policy, any hardware purchases over $300 will require your sign-off as Engineering lead.

2. Account & Tool Provisioning
   The refreshed onboarding guide calls for Day 1 access to: Meridian email, Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Figma, Notion, 1Password, and the Meridian platform (app.meridiananalytics.io). Could you or Liam confirm whether any additional engineering-specific tools or repos need to be pre-provisioned?

3. Software License Availability
   A few SKUs are running close to capacity and may need seat expansions before new hires come on board:
   - DataBridge (SKU-003): 28 of 30 licenses used — capacity upgrade already flagged to Hannah for Sep 15.
   - Custom Dashboard Builder (SKU-009): 22 of 25 seats used.
   - SSO Enterprise Module (SKU-007): 14 of 15 licenses used.
   Please let me know which of these the new engineers will need so we can action the expansions in time.

4. MFA & Security Training
   New hires must enable MFA on all accounts before Day 2 and complete Security Awareness training (~45 min) and GDPR & Data Handling training (~30 min) during Week 1. I'll coordinate scheduling on my end, but flagging in case your team wants to add any engineering-specific security briefings.

5. Open Support Tickets
   I noticed there are still open tickets (TKT-013, TKT-016, TKT-019) assigned to your team with a target closure of September 12. Wanted to flag this so we ensure platform stability before new team members start accessing the system.

Could we schedule a quick 15-minute sync this week to finalize the equipment list and provisioning checklist? Happy to work around your calendar.

Thanks for your help keeping this on track, Priya.

Best regards,
Kenji Obi
HR Manager
Meridian Analytics

import os
import sys
import fire
from email.message import EmailMessage

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".."))
from _log import log_tool_call

TESTBED_DIR = os.environ.get("OFFICEBENCH_TESTBED", "/workspace/testbed")


@log_tool_call("email.send_email")
def main(sender, recipient, subject, content):
    if "@" in sender:
        sender = sender.split("@")[0]
    if "@" in recipient:
        recipient = recipient.split("@")[0]
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(TESTBED_DIR, "emails", sender), exist_ok=True)
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(TESTBED_DIR, "emails", recipient), exist_ok=True)
        email = EmailMessage()
        email["From"] = sender + "@example.com"
        email["To"] = recipient + "@example.com"
        email["Subject"] = subject
        email.set_content(content)
        for folder in [sender, recipient]:
            email_file = os.path.join(TESTBED_DIR, "emails", folder, f"{subject}.eml")
            with open(email_file, "w") as f:
                f.write(email.as_string())
        return f"OBSERVATION: Successfully sent email to {recipient}."
    except Exception as e:
        return f"OBSERVATION: Failed to send email to {recipient}. Error: {e}"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    fire.Fire(main)
